from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Any, Dict

init_called = []

class Inner(BaseModel):
    name: str
    args: Dict[str, Any]
    fp: str = ""
    def __init__(self, **data):
        super().__init__(**data)
        init_called.append("inner-init")
        object.__setattr__(self, "fp", "HASH")

class Outer(BaseModel):
    items: list[Inner]

# direct construction
init_called.clear()
o = Outer(items=[{"name": "a", "args": {}}])
print("direct:", o.items[0].fp, init_called)

# model_validate
init_called.clear()
o = Outer.model_validate({"items": [{"name": "a", "args": {}}]})
print("validate:", o.items[0].fp, init_called)

# inner direct
init_called.clear()
i = Inner(name="a", args={})
print("inner direct:", i.fp, init_called)

# model_validate on inner
init_called.clear()
i = Inner.model_validate({"name": "a", "args": {}})
print("inner validate:", i.fp, init_called)

# model_dump roundtrip
print("dump:", o.model_dump())
o2 = Outer(**o.model_dump())
print("roundtrip fp:", o2.items[0].fp)
EOF

import hashlib, json
from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls, _canonicalize_tool_call_args, _tool_call_fingerprint

TC = ToolCalls.ToolCall

# 1. from_dict_list computes fingerprint
tcs = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}}])
tc = tcs.tool_calls[0]
print("fingerprint:", tc.fingerprint, len(tc.fingerprint))
print("id:", tc.id, len(tc.id))
assert len(tc.fingerprint) == 64 and tc.id == tc.fingerprint[:8]

# 2. Determinism: key order, tuple vs list, whitespace
a = TC(name="search", args={"b": 2, "a": "  hello  ", "nested": {"y": (1, 2), "x": " pad "}})
b = TC(name="search", args={"a": "hello", "b": 2, "nested": {"x": "pad", "y": [1, 2]}})
assert a.fingerprint == b.fingerprint, (a.fingerprint, b.fingerprint)
assert a.id == b.id
print("determinism OK:", a.fingerprint)

# 3. Canonicalization helper behavior
canon = _canonicalize_tool_call_args({"b": "  x ", "a": (1, " y ", [True, 2.5, None])})
assert canon == {"a": [1, "y", [True, 2.5, None]], "b": "x"}
assert type(canon["a"][0]) is int and type(canon["a"][2][0]) is bool
assert list(canon.keys()) == ["a", "b"]
print("canonicalize OK:", canon)

# 4. Name is included in fingerprint
c = TC(name="other", args={"a": "hello", "b": 2, "nested": {"x": "pad", "y": [1, 2]}})
assert c.fingerprint != a.fingerprint
print("name sensitivity OK")

# 5. Expected value recomputed manually
expected = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(
    {"name": "search", "args": {"a": "hello", "b": 2, "nested": {"x": "pad", "y": [1, 2]}}},
    sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
assert a.fingerprint == expected
print("manual hash match OK")

# 6. Different args -> different fingerprint
d = TC(name="search", args={"query": "world"})
assert d.fingerprint != tcs.tool_calls[0].fingerprint

# 7. model_validate / roundtrip consistency
tcs2 = ToolCalls.model_validate({"tool_calls": [{"name": "search", "args": {"query": "hello"}}]})
assert tcs2.tool_calls[0].fingerprint == tc.fingerprint
dumped = tc.model_dump()
tc3 = TC(**dumped)
assert tc3.fingerprint == tc.fingerprint
assert tcs == ToolCalls(tool_calls=[TC(name="search", args={"query": "hello"})])
print("roundtrip OK")

# 8. format() unaffected
assert tcs.format() == [{"type": "tool_calls", "tool_calls": [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "search", "arguments": {"query": "hello"}}}]}]
print("format OK")
print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
EOF
